Summary: Identity for private companies: resolve a selected subject to a private SEC filer (Form D issuer) by exact legal name, unique match, verified by the issuer's own Form D under its SEC CIK; unresolved states say what was checked
Description: 1) Original intent: the companies the Founder actually queries (Databento, Integrated Biosciences, Daytona, Anduril) are private and cannot resolve today: name resolution (KRYL-1407) and admission (KRYL-1380) cover listed companies only, so their packets say 'entity not resolved' and attribute nothing. Proposed (NOT yet ratified; pending the Founder and the Architects) identity class 1 of specs/proposal-private-company-identity-form-d-20261012.md (identity only). 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) a name resolves to a Form D issuer only when its name with legal suffixes removed equals exactly ONE Form D issuer's name; look-alike vehicles (Databento: AVSF - Databento 2026, LLC; FDC DATABENTO LLC; Anduril: 75 investor vehicles) never bind; several equal names stay unresolved; (b) the issuer is verified by a Form D filed under that CIK; the entity is admitted identity-only (SEC CIK anchor) and labelled 'private SEC filer (Form D), not listed' with the accession and date of the Form D; (c) registry, SEC listed company, SEC annual-report filer and existing resolutions are unchanged and take precedence; (d) an unresolved subject states which identity sources were actually checked and what each returned (no match, ambiguous with the candidate names listed and not assumed, lookup failed), names the sources not checked, and never claims a registry was checked that was not; (e) Databento resolves to Databento Inc. (CIK 0001784241) and Integrated Biosciences to Integrated Biosciences, Inc. (CIK 0002148371); Daytona and Anduril stay unresolved with the explanation; (f) no relationship, score or evidence is attributed from a similar-name entity or from field-level activity; (g) the identity and its provenance reach the entity card, Analysis, MAP and History through the existing path; (h) tests over recorded SEC responses and a live check. Not in scope (pending separate rulings): Form D related persons as LABOR, Form D offerings as CAPITAL observations, GLEIF, Companies House, UEI. 3) Current implementation state: proposal measured 2026-10-12; implementation starting. 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1380 (admission), KRYL-1407 (name resolution), KRYL-1372 (subject selection). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no; relaxes KRYL-1380's 'listed' criterion for this class only. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes (subject first, identity by SEC CIK, evidence-bound). Not counted as coverage toward the 8/10 objective by itself.
